name: Fleet Check Framework Pack
generated_by: verdictrow-site/fleet_check_framework_pack.py from the StallRow FLEET_CHECK_PACK_* constants (parsed from app/services/recheck.py + fleetcheck.py) and the canonical fleet route registry

pack.credits_unit: one credit = one whole-fleet sweep of the pack's fixed fleet definition, never one route

renewal.how: Buy a new pack at POST /v1/fleet-check/pack; deliveries carry these same terms in their `renewal` section, with days_remaining computed from the pack's real expiry.

payment.note: The pack and single sweep are paid via x402; pack runs spend pack credits and the status read is free — neither makes an x402 payment.

buy_pack.body: resources and/or origins (the pack's FIXED fleet definition), optional webhook_url, email, heartbeat, interval_s (300-86400)
buy_pack.returns: pack_id, definition, credits_total/credits_remaining, expires_at, renewal terms

run_sweep.returns: summary, run-over-run diff, credits_remaining, framework_log, renewal terms; new failures and recoveries are also pushed to the pack's webhook

status.returns: pack (definition, credits, expiry, renewal terms), latest sweep table, that sweep's framework_log, webhook delivery records

single_sweep.returns: the sweep table (resources, origins, summary) plus framework_log

framework_log.where: Every Fleet Check delivery (single sweep, pack run, pack status) carries a top-level `framework_log` list, additive to the original delivery fields.
framework_log.shape: One structured entry per probed resource, in sweep order — shaped so an AgentKit / LangChain-style runner can drop the entries into its own run log verbatim.

entry_fields.action: same as tool (frameworks that key run logs by action)
entry_fields.defect: the first defect's code (e.g. server_error, amount_mismatch, payto_mismatch, no_402, challenge_undecodable, unreachable), or null when OK
entry_fields.defects: all defect codes for the resource (possibly empty)
entry_fields.http_status: HTTP status the unpaid probe met, or null when unreachable
entry_fields.message: one-line human-readable summary of the entry

fixture_example.note: Synthetic example entries in the live format — fixture data, not a real sweep.

framework_log.message: fleet_check_route_probe https://service.example.com/v1/endpoint: OK — answers 402 with a parseable challenge, no defect found
fleet_check_route_probe https://service.example.com/v1/broken: DOWN (server_error: target returned HTTP 500)

actions: buy_fleet_check_pack ($5.00, hand-written — above the <=$0.05 pack-generated cap)
agentkit.note: The provider's other 24 actions are generated from the function-calling pack (routes <= $0.05); the Fleet Check actions are separate hand-written actions because Fleet Check is priced above that cap.
